canonical_example.text: ¿Cuántos ángulos rectos puede tener un triángulo equilátero?
canonical_example.translation: How many right angles can an equilateral triangle have?

canonical_example.text: El tumor fue descubierto gracias a una inspección de colon, recto y ano.
canonical_example.translation: The tumor was discovered after an inspection of the colon, rectum, and anus.

canonical_example.text: Cuando llegues al primer semáforo, sigue recto.
canonical_example.translation: When you get to the first light, continue straight.

canonical_example.text: Nada recto hasta que llegues a la otra orilla del lago.
canonical_example.translation: Swim straight on until you reach the other shore of the lake.

canonical_example.text: Camina recto 100 metros y dobla a la izquierda.
canonical_example.translation: Walk straight ahead for 100 meters and turn left.

canonical_example.text: Siéntate recto o te va a comenzar a doler la espalda.
canonical_example.translation: Sit up straight or your back will begin to hurt.

canonical_example.text: Se sentó recta en el sofá cuando oyó a alguien entrar en la casa.
canonical_example.translation: She sat upright on the sofa when she heard someone entering the house.

canonical_example.text: Martha es una mujer recta que nunca diría semejante mentira.
canonical_example.translation: Martha is a honest woman who would never tell such a lie.

canonical_example.text: Es un hombre recto que solo quiere lo mejor para su familia.
canonical_example.translation: He is an honorable man who only wants the best for his family.

ignored.reason: English gloss locale, not target-language usage

canonical_example.text: Detrás de ese político recto, hay un tirano despiadado.
canonical_example.translation: Behind that honourable politician there is a ruthless tyrant.

ignored.reason: English gloss locale, not target-language usage

canonical_example.text: Se puso triste cuando supo que la había perdido.
canonical_example.translation: He felt sad when he knew he had lost her.

canonical_example.text: Estaba muy triste porque no iba a volver a verlo.
canonical_example.translation: She felt very melancholy because she was not going to see him again.

canonical_example.text: Qué triste está este cuarto con las ventanas cerradas.
canonical_example.translation: This room looks very gloomy with the windows closed.

canonical_example.text: Lo hizo por cuatro tristes pesos.
canonical_example.translation: He did it for a few miserable pesos.

canonical_example.text: Es un triste consuelo saber que no sufrió.
canonical_example.translation: Knowing he did not suffer is of meager comfort.

canonical_example.text: No me gusta escuchar tristes los domingos por la noche.
canonical_example.translation: I do not like to listen to sad songs on Sunday evenings.

canonical_example.text: Su pelo largo atraía la atención de todo el mundo donde fuera.
canonical_example.translation: Her long hair attracted everyone's attention wherever she went.

canonical_example.text: El polo negativo atrae al polo positivo.
canonical_example.translation: The negative pole attracts the positive pole.

canonical_example.text: El vino atrae a las avispas.
canonical_example.translation: Wine attracts wasps.

canonical_example.text: Sus hermosos ojos oscuros me atraían.
canonical_example.translation: His beautiful dark eyes attracted me.

canonical_example.text: No me atraen los museos.
canonical_example.translation: Museums don't appeal to me.

canonical_example.text: Mira cómo esos músculos atraen la atención de todas las chicas.
canonical_example.translation: Look at how those muscles draw the attention of all the girls.

canonical_example.text: El queso atrajo el ratón a la trampa.
canonical_example.translation: The cheese drew the mouse to the trap.

canonical_example.text: Se atrajeron mutuamente desde el principio.
canonical_example.translation: They were attracted to each other from the very first moment.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to be attracted to each other

canonical_example.text: Aprendí en la escuela que el Sol y la Tierra se atraen.
canonical_example.translation: I learned at school that the Sun and the Earth attract each other.

unused_menu_senses.context: to exert a force on an object

source_metadata.context: to exert a force on an object

canonical_example.text: Se atrajo el respeto de sus compañeros al conseguir un cliente importante.
canonical_example.translation: He won the respect of his colleagues when he acquired an important client.
